en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  Imam  Ja’far  Sadiq  (a.s.)  said,  “Surely  Allah,  the  Mighty and Sublime has created the believers with the light of His greatness  and  the  majesty  of  His  supremacy.  Hence,  one who taunts him or turns a deaf ear to his words has rejected Allah on His throne. He will not get anything from Allah; he is only a partner of Shaitaan.”
